## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 5 dishes (as Cabo Verde), none Cape Verde-only; [[FmLAMA]]: 1 dish (cachupa, 14 rows).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) includes the FAO/INFOODS **West African Food Composition Table (WAFCT)**, a regional table for the ECOWAS countries including Cape Verde; processing it is the most direct way to get local foods (fonio, cowpea, shea, baobab, leafy sauces). Until then, use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 48 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Cape Verde on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown). Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).
